chunks.content:
17. TRAFFIC SIGNS, MARKINGS AND OTHER ROAD FURNITURE

Road markings and road signs standards are proposed based on IRC standards.
The road furniture proposed to be provided includes

Routine and special road signs, hectometer, kilometer and 200 m stones.
warning/caution/informatory signs ; Road marking - standard centre-line & edge
marking using thermoplastic paints; Boundary pillars at 100m c/c on both sides of
the road ; Road Delineators and Guard posts for embankment height 1.2m to 3.0m;
W-beam metal beam crash barrier for embankment height > 3.0m; reflective
pavement marker with micro prismatic lens at curves and junctions; Gantry Sign
boards etc. 3 nos. of gantry sign boards are proposed.

ESs-11

18 LAND ACQUISITION
The Right of Way has generally been proposed as 60m.

Mostly the area proposed for acquisition is Agricultural, semi built-up & open
countryside.

The preparation of Land Acquisition and Utility Shifting estimate is under
process and will be submitted immediately on receipt of the same.

19. SUMMARY OF EIA

Guidelines formulated by Ministry of Environment & Forest (MOEF) will be referred to
for preparing the EIA. Following are the major tasks proposed to be conducted as a
part of EIA study.

* Preliminary reconnaissance survey and collection of secondary information to
identify environmentally sensitive issues relating to the project.

* Identification of base line status of various environmental parameters through
environmental monitoring study.

« Assessment of potential impacts of the project on these base line conditions.

* Formulation of Environment Management Plan (EMP) incorporating appropriate
mitigation measures to offset the identified adverse impacts, and Environmental
Monitoring Plan for evaluating the effective implementation of EMP.

e Estimation of cast for EMP and Monitoring Plan and

¢ Formulation of Institutional arrangement for the implementation of EMP.

The Detailed Project Report has been prepared in-house by engaging local consultant for

specialized work of total station survey of the alignment, sub-soil investigation for RCC

bridges etc. Environmental Impact Assessment is a specialized work. This study was not

in the scope of works of the local consultant.

However, a detailed environmental impact assessment will have to be carried out and

mitigation measures should be proposed and carried out on the basis of the detailed

environmental impact assessment. A consultancy estimate for undertaking the EIA and

preparation of EMP will be submitted to the Ministry immediately for necessary sanction.

ES-12

20 ECONOMIC ANALYSIS

Since this project is proposed to be executed under EPC by the National Highway wing of
the Assam PWD (Building & NH), the Economic Analysis of the project has not been

carried out.

21. CONSULTANCY

The Detailed Project Report has been prepared in-house by engaging local consultant for
specialized work of total station survey of the alignment, sub-soil investigation for RCC

bridges etc.

Environmental Impact Assessment is a specialized work. This study was not in the scope
of works of the sanctioned estimate. However, a detailed environmental impact
assessment will have to be carried out and mitigation measures should be proposed and
carried out on the basis of the detailed environmental impact assessment. An amount
for engaging consultants for undertaking the EIA and preparation of EMP has been

included in the estimate.

Moreover, structural consultants will have to be engaged for the detailed design of two
flyovers proposed to be provided at Dolabari and Jamuguri as well as the detailed

investigation, design and detailing of the 1200m long major bridge over river Jia-Bharali.
